### [llm-gemini 0.34](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Sep/2/llm-gemini/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-09-02

Version 0.34 of the llm-gemini plugin adds support for Google's new Gemini 3.8 Flash model, featuring low, medium, and high thinking levels, alongside a fix for async model version tracking.

- Added the gemini-3.8-flash model with configurable thinking levels (low, medium, high).
- Fixed issue #137 where async responses failed to record the resolved model version.
- Demonstrated practical code generation capabilities by building an HTML interactive demo in 13 seconds for 1.8 cents.
- Used Gemini 3.8 Flash to add sandboxed iframe HTML rendering support to the markdown-svg-renderer tool.

**Why it matters:** It enables developers using the llm CLI tool to access Google's latest fast, low-cost Gemini 3.8 Flash model with configurable reasoning depth.

### [Claude's new system prompt really doesn't want to reproduce song lyrics](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Sep/2/claudes-new-system-prompt/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-09-02

Anthropic updated system prompts for models like Claude Fable 5.1 to strictly prohibit reproducing copyrighted song lyrics, modern poems, book excerpts, and generating visual code depicting copyrighted characters or logos.

- Claude is instructed to decline reproducing post-1929 song lyrics, poems, and book passages, including partial lines, choruses, or user-pasted excerpts.
- Once a copyright request is declined, Claude must maintain the refusal against narrowed or reworded prompts for the rest of the conversation.
- Prohibitions extend to code-based visual generations (SVG, HTML/CSS, ASCII art) representing specific artworks, logos, or recognizable characters like Sonic.
- Anthropic now organizes model system prompts on individual pages accessible as plain Markdown via .md URLs, with reliable knowledge cutoff dates set to June 2026.

**Why it matters:** These prompt restrictions directly mitigate copyright infringement liability around text generation and programmatic visual assets amid ongoing lawsuits from music publishers.

`anthropic` `claude` `system-prompts` `copyright` `llm-safety`
